battle.name: 唐滅輔公祏之戰
battle.brief: 武德六年（623）八月，隋末首領輔公祏在丹陽舉兵，國號宋，據巢縣，遣將屯涇縣、蕪湖斷唐軍糧道。唐以李孝恭為江南道行臺尚書令、李世勳為行軍總管，率舟師步騎順江而下，破涇縣、蕪湖，兵臨巢縣；輔公祏夜走句容被擒，檻送京師誅之。卡面秦連弩為秦制舊物，此役弩機壓城頭、掩護攻牆的用處仍可見。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是唐高祖李淵新建的朝廷，另一方是隋末淮南起義殘部演化出來的割據勢力。唐方在中央由尚書省與諸行臺調度兵資，具體執行此役的是江南道行臺尚書令李孝恭與行軍總管李世勳所率的舟師、步騎與器械隊；兵源一部分是關隴、河南的宿衛與禁軍，一部分是杜伏威降唐後被收編的淮南舊部，還有沿江宣州、池州、饒州、洪州各州縣調集的團練與鄉兵，水軍則靠江淮船戶改建的舟師與當地水軍工匠。輔公祏一方則是杜伏威起義軍的殘餘：那支起義原本是長白山一帶的流民與山民武裝，隋亡之後始終保有自己的舟師、城防器械與部曲名籍，輔公祏舉兵後自稱帝、國號宋，以巢縣為都，置百官、設官屬，遣部將分屯涇縣、蕪湖，並一度聯絡長江下游與皖南若干州縣。雙方對比明顯：唐有國家賦稅、關中兵源與造船能力，輔公祏有熟悉江淮水道的地利與舊部人情，卻缺少穩定的財賦與外援，戰局很快向唐方傾斜。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the court of the Tang founder Li Yuan on one hand, and on the other a separatist force that had grown out of the surviving bands of the late Sui peasant rising in the Huai River region. On the Tang side the central government handled the dispatch of troops and supplies through the Department of State Affairs and the regional headquarters, while the actual conduct of the campaign fell to Li Xiaogong, Director of the Department of State Affairs of the Jiangnan Circuit, and to Li Shiji, commander-in-chief of the expedition, with their war-junks, their foot and horse and their train of engines. The manpower came partly from the imperial guards and the garrison troops of Guanzhong and Henan, partly from the old followers of Du Fuwei who had been incorporated after his submission, and partly from the militia and village levies mustered by the prefectures of Xuanzhou, Chizhou, Raozhou and Hongzhou along the river; the naval force rested on the river boatmen of the Huai and the Yangtze converted into war-junks and on the shipwrights of the local flotillas. The side of Fu Gongshi was the remnant of Du Fuwei's rebel army. That movement had begun among the refugees and hill folk of the Changbai Mountains, and even after the fall of the Sui it kept its own flotilla, its siege and defence equipment and its muster rolls of the original troopers. After raising his banner Fu Gongshi proclaimed himself emperor, set up the state of Song, made Chao County his capital, appointed a hundred officials and assumed the titles of commanderies and counties; he posted his generals at Jing County and at Wuhu and sounded out several prefectures and counties of the lower Yangtze and of southern Anhui. The contrast was plain: the Tang had the tax revenue of the state, the manning of Guanzhong and the shipbuilding capacity of the empire, while Fu had the advantage of knowing the waterways of the Huai and the Yangtze and the loyalties of the old troops, but he lacked stable revenue and outside help, and the balance tipped quickly to the Tang side.
people: 輔公祏是此役的主角。隋末他在泰山、長白山一帶聚眾，與同鄉杜伏威結為兄弟，眾軍呼他「輔相公」，兩人合兵之後成為江淮最大的武裝集團之一。隋亡後杜伏威於武德二年歸唐，輔公祏同受封爵，官拜淮南行省尚書令，掌一方軍政。杜伏威於武德五年入朝後不久病逝於長安，輔公祏失去了最大的政治屏障；史書另載有流言說伏威之死與輔公祏有關，但兩說並存、皆屬傳聞，不足為憑。輔公祏的部將與舊交多勸他靜觀以待，輔仍於武德六年八月在丹陽舉兵，稱帝建宋，沿用舊部名籍與械具，旬月之間聲勢頗盛。另一邊，主管此役的兩位唐將性格迥異：江南道行臺尚書令李孝恭是宗室子、封淮安郡王，臨事謹慎卻屢屢逗留觀望；行軍總管李世勳即徐世勳，是隋末平定竇建德、貞觀初又參與平定劉黑闐的宿將，他主張速戰，屢催李孝恭進兵。涇縣、蕪湖兩處的守將是輔公祏部將楊普亮與樂玄武；輔公祏又派其子伏瑗以宋王之名率精兵前往救援。巢縣城破之夜，輔公祏帶著少數人突圍向東，馳往句容，最終被自己的部將、突騎將張金友擒獲，檻送京師。
peopleEn: Fu Gongshi is the central figure of this campaign. At the end of the Sui he gathered followers in the region of Mount Tai and the Changbai Mountains and swore brotherhood with a fellow townsman, Du Fuwei; the rebel host called him the Grand Duke Fu, and after the two of them joined their forces they became one of the largest armed groups in the Huai and the Yangtze. After the Sui fell, Du Fuwei submitted to the Tang in the second year of Wude, Fu was enfeoffed alongside him and was appointed to the post of president of the Huainan region, in charge of the military and civil administration there. Du Fuwei was summoned to the capital in the fifth year of Wude and died of illness at Chang'an not long afterwards, and Fu lost the one political shield that had protected him. The histories also preserve a rumour that Du's death was connected with Fu Gongshi, but the two versions stand side by side and both are hearsay, not evidence. Many of Fu's officers and old friends urged him to wait and see, but he raised his banner at Danyang in the eighth month of the sixth year of Wude, proclaimed himself emperor and founded the state of Song, keeping the muster rolls and the equipment of the old troops; within a few weeks his strength looked considerable. On the Tang side the two commanders were of quite different tempers. Li Xiaogong, Director of the Department of State Affairs of the Jiangnan Circuit, was a kinsman of the imperial house and enfeoffed as Prince of Huai'an; careful in his conduct, he yet hung back and watched from a distance again and again. Li Shiji, the commander-in-chief, was Xu Shiji before the grant of the imperial surname, a veteran who had broken Dou Jiande at the end of the Sui and had served in the suppression of Liu Heiting at the beginning of the Zhenguan era; he argued for the quick decision and pressed Li Xiaogong to advance. The defenders of Jing County and of Wuhu were Fu Gongshi's generals Yang Puliang and Yue Xuanwu, and Fu also sent his son Fu Yuan, who bore the title King of Song, with picked troops to relieve them. On the night the city of Chao fell, Fu broke out with only a few men and rode east towards Jurong, and in the end he was taken by one of his own officers, the commander of the swift cavalry Zhang Jinyou, and sent to the capital in a cage.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是秦連弩，一種把拉力存進弩機、一踩一發的連發弩機，傳世形制見於秦漢之際韓、趙連弩的記載，專為守城壓制攻城人流而設。必須說明的是：隋唐之世距秦制已逾八百年，連發弩機早已失傳，官方兵書所載的唐弩仍是張一發一，如《唐六典》所記擘張、蹶張、兼擘三法，步卒用蹶張弩以上弦之力，城頭則用擘張的強弩與弩砲。故此役中弩的位置格外吃重：唐軍以弩手居前齊射，壓制巢縣城頭的射角，再以步卒填壕、扛雲梯衝牆；輔公祏一方則靠城頭弩手與江上舟師的弩砲封住渡口，使唐軍不敢輕易泅渡。攻城器械方面，隋唐江淮攻守常用投石拋擊城頭、以撞車撞擊門牆、雲梯攀城，並在營前列拒馬、鹿角與羓藁。舟師一端的技術總結，見於相傳唐人李筌《太白陰經》所記的鬥艦、艨艟與突江艇，船上備有床弩與拍杆，可壓制沿岸城頭。糧食方面，涇縣、蕪湖兩處據點正卡在江淮漕運線上，唐軍必須先解決運道，才能把大軍推展到巢縣城下。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow, a crossbow machine that stores the pull of the bow in the lock and sends an arrow with a stamp of the foot; the transmitted forms come from the accounts of the Han and Zhao repeating crossbows of the Qin-Han period, and the weapon was made for the defence of walls, to hold the men coming up them down. One point has to be made plainly: by the Sui and the Tang the Qin forms had been lost for more than eight hundred years, and the crossbows described in the official military manuals of the Tang still shot a single bolt at a time. The Tang Six Compendia records three ways of drawing the bow, the braced pull, the draw with the waist and the combined pull, with the foot soldier using the waist-drawn crossbow and the wall and the siege engine using the strongly drawn crossbow and the bolt-thrower. The crossbow therefore held a position of special weight in this campaign. The Tang troops put the crossbowmen in front to shoot in unison, so as to hold down the firing angles of the walls of Chao County, and then sent the foot forward to fill the ditch and carry the scaling ladders to the wall. Fu Gongshi's side in turn used the crossbowmen on the wall and the bolt-throwers of the river flotilla to seal the crossings, so that the Tang army would not attempt the water in force. Among the siege engines, campaigns along the Huai and the Yangtze in the Sui and the Tang commonly used the stone-thrower to pound the parapet, the ram to beat at gates and walls and scaling ladders against the wall, with tripods and caltrops and thorn faggots planted in front of the camp. The naval side of the technology is summed up in the accounts of the fighting ships, the mengchong and the light river craft preserved in the Taibai Yinjing, attributed to the Tang writer Li Quan, which carried bed crossbows and beating poles for use against the shore defences. As for supply, the positions at Jing County and at Wuhu sat directly on the grain route of the Huai and the Yangtze, and the Tang army had to reopen that route before it could spread its main force up under the walls of Chao County.
tactics: 此役的戰術主軸是水陸並行、以舟師先斷漕運。輔公祏據巢縣、控江面，唐軍若只走陸路，糧車就會被其部將在涇縣、蕪湖的據點卡住，因此李世勳率舟師自池州順流而下，李孝恭自舒州、宣州一線沿江東進，兩路形成夾擊之勢；史載二將初皆逗留，經朝廷遣使切責才相率而進。涇縣之戰是典型的夜襲：李世勳遣劉邯率驍騎乘夜渡水，先破楊普亮部，切斷巢縣的外援；其後輔公祏遣伏瑗率精兵來援，唐軍以弩陣齊射在前、步騎繼之，一戰生擒伏瑗並全潰其精兵。蕪湖的舟師對峙中，唐軍以弩砲與撞船並用，破了樂玄武的水寨。進抵巢縣後，唐軍不急於猛攻，先圍城斷絕內外交通，列營立寨、築土壘、分番值守，日夜以弩手與投石打擊城頭，逼迫輔公祏屢次出兵反撲；唐軍則以弩箭壓住出兵的隊形，待其陣腳一亂再以騎兵衝擊。輔軍屢敗之後，部眾人心崩潰，突圍時隊形全無，輔公祏只與少數人馳向句容。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of the campaign was the advance by water and by land together, with the war-junks cutting the grain route first. Fu Gongshi sat at Chao County and controlled the river; if the Tang army came by land alone its baggage train would be caught by his garrisons at Jing County and at Wuhu. Li Shiji therefore took the war-junks down the river from Chizhou, while Li Xiaogong moved east along the bank from Shuzhou and Xuanzhou, and the two lines closed on the enemy like a pair of pincers. The histories record that at first both commanders hung back, and that they only moved forward together after the court sent envoys to rebuke them sharply. The action at Jing County was a textbook night attack: Li Shiji sent Liu Han with picked cavalry across the water by night, broke Yang Puliang's command first and cut the relief of Chao County; afterwards Fu Gongshi sent Fu Yuan with picked troops to the rescue, and the Tang army shot a rank of crossbow bolts in front and followed with foot and horse, taking Fu Yuan alive in the battle and scattering his best troops entirely. At Wuhu the two fleets stood off, and the Tang used bolt-throwers and rams against the water stockade of Yue Xuanwu. On reaching Chao County the Tang did not rush the place: they surrounded the city first and cut its communications, pitched camp, raised earthen ramparts, set watches by rota and never relaxed, striking the parapet day and night with crossbowmen and stone-throwers, and wearing down Fu Gongshi into repeated counter-attacks. The Tang answered by raining bolts that disordered the order of the sortie and only charged with cavalry once that formation broke. After the repeated defeats the morale of the rebel troops broke down, their column lost all order as it broke out, and Fu Gongshi rode towards Jurong with only a handful of men.
data: 關於數字，現存史冊對此役的記載相當簡略，只能取其約數。時間上，輔公祏於武德六年（623）八月在丹陽舉兵，唐軍同月出兵、十月攻破巢縣，全役自起兵到城破約歷兩月餘，輔公祏被擒送京師則在十月之後。兵力上，唐方史稱舟師、步騎、兵數萬，但明確的編制數字並不見於傳世記載；輔公祏一方能投入的兵力當與淮南舊部相當，其派往涇縣的援軍屬精兵一級的部隊，戰敗後被生擒者除宋王伏瑗外，尚有精騎大部。距離上，涇縣、蕪湖在巢縣以西，唐軍自池州至蕪湖水程約二百里，自蕪湖至巢縣又約百餘里；巢縣至句容約一百五十里，輔公祏的突圍路線大致沿此線向東北。城池上，巢縣是輔公祏自建的據點，築宮室、置百官，牆垣夯築，弩位與城頭通道是防守關鍵。器械上，弩屬制式裝備，唐弩弓力以石計，步卒弩與城頭弩砲分列兩種張力等級。損耗方面，敗陣被俘者以精兵計，唐軍在江上亦有舟船損失，具體數目史無明文。
dataEn: On numbers, the surviving records of this campaign are very terse, and only approximate figures can be taken from them. In time, Fu Gongshi raised his banner at Danyang in the eighth month of the sixth year of Wude, 623; the Tang army took the field in the same month and took Chao County in the tenth, so the whole affair from the rising to the fall of the city lasted a little over two months, and Fu Gongshi was sent to the capital in a cage after that. In strength, the Tang side is referred to in the histories as a flotilla and foot and horse of several tens of thousands of men, but no clear figures for the establishment survive; the forces Fu could bring to bear were of the order of the old Huai troops, and the relief he sent to Jing County was a picked body of the first rank, of those taken alive after the defeat were the King of Song Fu Yuan and the bulk of the fast cavalry. In distance, Jing County and Wuhu lie west of Chao County; the water run from Chizhou to Wuhu is about two hundred li, and from Wuhu to Chao County rather more than a hundred li further, while the road from Chao County to Jurong is about a hundred and fifty li, and Fu Gongshi's flight ran in effect along that line to the north-east. As for the city, Chao County was a position that Fu Gongshi had built himself, with palaces, a hundred officials and rammed-earth walls, and the bolt positions and the passages of the parapet were the keys of the defence. In equipment the crossbow was a standard item: the pull of a Tang crossbow was reckoned in stone, with separate grades of tension for the crossbow of the foot soldier and for the bolt-thrower of the wall. As for losses, those taken prisoner after the defeat were counted among the picked troops, and the Tang army also lost craft on the river, but no figures are recorded.
cause: 起兵的緣由有三層。第一層是杜伏威之死：武德五年，淮南巨頭杜伏威應召入朝並在長安病逝，他生前以推心置腹的方略安撫降唐舊部，其入朝使淮南集團失去重心；輔公祏既懼朝廷事後清算，又怕失去淮南的兵、糧與人心，於是先發制人。第二層是杜伏威舊部在降唐之後仍保持相當的獨立性：淮南兵將沿用原有的部曲編制與裝備，唐廷對其只是改換旗號與官職，未能拆散其人脈，輔公祏在淮南仍能一呼而集，舉兵之後長江下游與皖南數處州縣一度響應，州縣官吏多有觀望。第三層是唐廷的戰略困境：武德六年上半年河北劉黑闐之亂方平，唐軍主力剛由北方抽回，關中宿衛與洛陽、洛州方向的兵馬需要重新部署，淮南用兵只能以淮南降兵為主、監軍大臣為輔，這種兵源與名分上的不匹配，正是輔公祏敢於稱帝建號的依據。
causeEn: There are three layers to the reason the war began. The first is the death of Du Fuwei. In the fifth year of Wude the great leader of the Huai, Du Fuwei, was summoned to the capital and died of illness at Chang'an; in life he had settled his surrendered followers with an open hand, and his departure to court left the Huai group without its centre. Fu Gongshi, fearing that the court would now call the whole thing to account and equally afraid of losing the troops, the grain and the hearts of the Huai, struck first. The second is the degree of independence the old Huai troops kept even after surrendering to the Tang: the commanders and soldiers of the Huai kept their original units and their equipment, and the court only changed their banners and titles without being able to dissolve the network of personal ties among them, so that Fu Gongshi could still raise thousands at a call in the Huai; and when he rose, several prefectures and counties of the lower Yangtze and of southern Anhui answered him for a time, their officials much given to sitting on the fence. The third is the strategic predicament of the court. The rising of Liu Heiting in the north had only just been put down in the first half of the sixth year of Wude, the main body of the Tang army had just been drawn back from the north, and the garrison of Guanzhong and the troops on the Luoyang and the Luozhou fronts had to be redeployed, so that the army sent against Huai could be made up mainly of surrendered Huai troops with a supervising minister in attendance; this mismatch in manpower and in standing was exactly the basis on which Fu Gongshi dared to call himself emperor and found a state.
impact: 此役的結果直接改變了唐初的戰略地圖。淮南集團的瓦解，使李唐在長江以南再無成建制的武裝割據，江南的州縣重新回到朝廷的編制之內，賦稅、漕運與徵兵通道恢復暢通；同時，輔公祏部下的數萬兵眾被拆散整編，一部分留在淮西與江東，成為唐軍在南方的主要兵源，其將佐日後多有顯於軍鎮者，這批由叛軍轉為官軍的人馬，成為唐中期藩鎮格局的遠源之一。更上層看，輔公祏之死意味著隋末群雄中最後一位仍據江南而未被朝廷收編的首領被清除，唐得以騰出全力對付北方的劉黑闐與東突厥，也才有餘裕在貞觀年間經營西域與高句麗。就兵器與攻城技術而言，此役再次證明弩砲與弩手在江淮城防中的樞紐地位：對壘雙方都把弩配置在城頭、舟船與營壘三個層面，這種以弩箭劃定火力線、限制對方推進距離的做法，正是秦連弩一類連發弩機在唐代所留下的功能痕跡。
impactEn: The outcome of this campaign changed the strategic map of the early Tang at once. The breakup of the Huai group left the Li Tang with no organized armed separatism south of the Yangtze; the prefectures of the south returned to the administrative and fiscal system of the court, and the channels of taxation, of the grain transport and of recruitment ran freely again. At the same time the tens of thousands of men who had served under Fu Gongshi were broken up and re-enrolled, a part of them staying in Huaixi and in Jiangdong and becoming a main source of the Tang army's strength in the south; several of their officers were later prominent in the military governorships of the middle Tang, and this body of men who passed from rebel troops to imperial soldiers is one of the distant springs of the late Tang pattern of regional commands. On the larger stage, the death of Fu Gongshi meant that the last of the late Sui warlords who still held the south without having been incorporated by the court had been removed, so that the Tang could free its strength for Liu Heiting in the north and for the Eastern Turks, and only then have had the margin to conduct affairs in the Western Regions and against Goguryeo in the Zhenguan years. As for arms and siegecraft, the campaign once again demonstrated the hinge position of the bolt-thrower and of the crossbowman in the defence of the cities of the Huai and the Yangtze: both sides at grips placed the crossbow at three levels, the parapet, the ship and the stockade, and this practice of drawing a line of fire with the bolt and so limiting the distance the enemy could advance is the trace that a repeating crossbow machine such as the Qin crossbow left behind in the Tang.
result: 唐軍攻破巢縣之後，輔公祏的割據迅速瓦解。城破之時，輔公祏與宋王伏瑗等率殘部突圍，方向是句容；唐軍追擊不斷，輔公祏最後被自己的部將、突騎將張金友擒住，檻車送京師。高祖念其舊日歸唐之功，一度有意寬免，侍臣力爭，以其罪不可貸進言，終於依軍法誅戮，妻孥及親黨亦受牽連處置。江南其餘州縣聞風歸順，淮南重新歸入唐的版籍，此後二十年不再有江南成股的割據。此役自八月至十月，前後約兩月餘，以唐軍在舟師上的突破與對巢縣的圍城殲滅戰收局；從結果看，李孝恭、李世勳以水陸夾擊之術對上輔公祏水陸分據之勢，唐方在戰略與補給兩端同時佔優，輔公祏則輸在兵源不純、號令不統一與糧道被切。
resultEn: After the Tang army took Chao County, Fu Gongshi's separatism collapsed quickly. At the breach, Fu and the King of Song Fu Yuan led a remnant out of the city in the direction of Jurong; the Tang pursued without slack, and Fu was at last taken by one of his own officers, the commander of the swift cavalry Zhang Jinyou, and carried to the capital in a cage. The high ancestor, mindful of the service he had rendered in submitting to the Tang, was for a while minded to pardon him; the ministers pressed hard in remonstrance, urging that his guilt could not be forgiven, and in the end he was executed under military law, with his wife, his children and his closest associates implicated in the disposal of the case. The remaining prefectures of the south came over on hearing the news, and Huai was brought back into the registers of the Tang, with no large southern separatism for the following twenty years. The campaign ran from the eighth to the tenth month, a little over two months in all, and closed with the Tang breakthrough on the river and the annihilation of Chao County. In the result, the tactics of the pincers by water and by land that Li Xiaogong and Li Shiji brought against Fu Gongshi's divided posture on land and water gave the Tang the advantage on both the strategic and the supply sides at once, while Fu lost through soldiers of mixed loyalty, divided orders and a grain route cut off.
